title: One Hive, separate account ownership
subtitle: Current GoNuts interface · optional connection
captionText: A Hive shares market information and a ledger between local Minecraft instances. Each account keeps its settings, orders, limits and recovery state. Headless mode is optional.

title: Find Hive setup
subtitle: Current GoNuts interface · optional connection
bullets: Or use Hive & commands in the panel
captionText: Open Accounts, Hive setup. Review locally detected accounts. In the browser panel, Hive and commands can add a fresh detected bot to an existing Hive without a game window.

title: Share and join safely
subtitle: Current GoNuts interface · optional connection
bullets: Select an existing Hive or paste its code
captionText: For the disconnected wizard, open Multiplayer, GoNuts hive. Share this hive on the existing account; use Link accounts and Review connection on the new instance. Keep the original data folder.

title: Choose the right operation
subtitle: Current GoNuts interface · optional connection
captionText: Choose Join existing hive for a fresh account. Existing histories use the separate supported combination flow. Never delete order records or a shared database to bypass a refusal.

title: Restart only the new member
subtitle: Current GoNuts interface · optional connection
captionText: After a new-account join confirms, restart only that new instance normally. Joining does not enable trading. The original settings and recovery gates remain authoritative.

title: Check one account or the whole Hive
subtitle: Current GoNuts interface · optional connection
bullets: Choose an account in the panel
captionText: Use the account selector on Money and Orders. One account shows only that account. All accounts combines the Hive. Unfilled order funds and delivered goods awaiting collection stay separate from auction asking revenue.
